description: This file defines the Catalyst controller for managing organizations within the Coocook application. It includes actions for creating, viewing, updating, deleting, and leaving organizations, with associated permission checks and data handling.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::Organization
classes.description: Catalyst controller class for organization management, extending Coocook::Controller.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles creation of a new organization, validating input, checking name availability, and redirecting after creation.

methods.name: base
methods.description: Captures organization by name from URL, setting it in stash, or detaching to error if not found.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays organization details, including users and projects, with permission checks.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates organization description and display name based on submitted form data.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the organization and redirects to appropriate page based on user capabilities.

methods.name: leave
methods.description: Allows a user to leave an organization.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Private method to redirect to the organization show page.
